E-PARADA: CROSS-FUNCTIONAL END-TO-END SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE FLOWCHART
Flutter Mobile Client (ph.eparada.mobile) • Laravel Backend REST API & Sanctum • Space Provider • System Administrator • Supabase PostgreSQL, Brevo SMTP & Cloud Integrations
SYSTEM LIFECYCLE PHASES
FLUTTER CLIENT: DRIVER / USER APP
LARAVEL REST API & CONTROLLER ENGINE
PARKING SPACE PROVIDER (HOST)
SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR CONSOLE
DATABASE, HARDWARE & EXTERNAL SERVICES

PHASE 1

AUTHENTICATION,
ONBOARDING &
KYC VERIFICATION

• User & Provider Sign Up
• ID Document Upload
• Vehicle Inspection KYC
• Sanctum Token Issuance
• Admin Approval Workflow

Driver / User Registration
Enters Name, Email, Password, Role (Driver),
Plate Number, Vehicle Make/Color/Model,
Consent & Uploads ID + Vehicle Photos

Provider Registration
Enters Name, Email, Password, Role (Owner),
Uploads Valid ID Front/Back & Permits

[POST /api/register]
Controller receives multipart payload.
Validates fields, email uniqueness, file formats

Payload & Files
Valid?

[422 Unprocessable Entity]
Display validation errors on Mobile UI

Database: Insert Users & Vehicles
• INSERT INTO users (status: 'pending')
• INSERT INTO vehicles (status: 'pending')
• Store ID & Vehicle photos to storage/app

Sanctum Token & Brevo Email Verification
Issue Bearer Token & dispatch signed
email verification link via Brevo SMTP relay

Save Session Locally
Store auth_token, user_id, role,
can_reserve flag to SharedPreferences

Admin Fetches Pending Verifications
[GET /api/admin/users?status=pending]
[GET /api/admin/vehicles?status=pending]

Inspect KYC Documents & Photos
Fetch private streams: [GET .../identity-document]
[GET .../identity-document/back] & [GET .../photo]

Admin Approve
Account & Vehicle?

[PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/reject]
[PATCH /api/admin/vehicles/{id}/reject]
Set verification_status='rejected' with notes

[PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/approve]
[PATCH /api/admin/vehicles/{id}/approve]
Set verification_status='approved',
can_reserve=1, can_manage_parking_spaces=1

Database: Update KYC Status
• UPDATE users SET verification_status='approved'
• UPDATE vehicles SET status='approved'

User / Driver Login Flow
[POST /api/login] with Email & Password
Validate credentials & fetch latest profile [GET /me]

Navigate to Main Navigation
Load Dashboard (Driver Home / Owner Hub / Admin Panel)
No (Validation Error)
Yes (Valid)
Pending KYC Queue

PHASE 2

PARKING SPACE
LISTING &
MANAGEMENT

• Space Geolocation Pinning
• Slot Vehicle Compatibility
• Operating Hours & Rules
• Admin Spatial Review
• Dynamic Rate Tiering

Host Opens Space Management
Provider selects "Add New Parking Space"
or loads existing listings [GET /api/owner/parking-spaces]

Fill Parking Space Specifications
• Space Name, Address, Lat/Long GPS Coordinates
• Total Dimensions (sqm), Total Slots Count
• 24/7 toggle or Opening & Closing Times
• Overstay Grace Period (mins), Abandoned Limit (hrs)

Configure Slot Vehicle Matrix
Define allowable vehicle types per individual slot:
Motorcycle, E-Trike/E-Quad, Car, SUV/MPV, Van/Pickup

[POST /api/owner/parking-spaces]
Controller receives multipart payload with images[].
Validates spatial geometry, slot limits, operating hours

Space Data &
Slots Valid?

Display Space Validation Errors
Highlight invalid hours, missing images, or slot mismatch

Database: Insert Parking Space
• INSERT INTO parking_spaces (approval_status: 'pending')
• INSERT INTO parking_slots (vehicle_type_bitmask)
• Store space gallery images to public storage disk

Admin Reviews Space Submission
[GET /api/admin/parking-spaces?status=pending]
Review dimensions, photos, geofence, and slots layout

Admin Configures Hourly Rate Tiers
Set vehicle_hourly_rates for Motorcycle, Car, SUV, Van.
Add operational approval notes

Admin Approve
Parking Space?

[PATCH /api/admin/parking-spaces/{id}/review]
Set approval_status='approved' (or 'rejected'),
attach hourly rates mapping & admin_notes

Database: Activate & Index Space
UPDATE parking_spaces SET approval_status='approved',
is_active=1, hourly_rates=json_payload
Spatial indexing active for Driver Discovery
No (Errors)
Yes (Valid)
Pending Space Review

PHASE 3

SEARCH, DISCOVERY
& REAL-TIME
RESERVATION

• Interactive Google Map
• Spatial Search & Filtering
• Real-Time Slot Conflict Check
• Reservation Lock & QR Pass
• Provider Booking Acceptance

Driver Opens Interactive Map Screen
Enables GPS location, sets vehicle type filter,
specifies intended reservation date/time window

Google Maps Platform
• Places API & Geocoding
• Dynamic Vector Map SDK
• Distance Matrix calculation

[GET /api/parking-spaces]
Query active, approved spaces within bounding box / radius.
Eager load slot capacities, hourly rates & average ratings

Interactive Map UI Rendering
Displays custom parking pins, rate badges, clustering,
and facility overview bottom sheets

Select Space & View Details
Driver clicks space -> Inspects photos, amenities,
allowed vehicle types, rules, and host ratings

Check Slot Real-Time Availability
Driver selects Vehicle from Garage, Start/End Date & Time
[GET /api/driver/parking-spaces/{id}/availability]

Availability Engine Conflict Check
Check operating hours, existing overlapping reservations,
matching slot vehicle compatibility, compute price quote

Submit Slot Reservation
[POST /api/driver/parking-spaces/{id}/reservations]
Pass vehicle_id, parking_slot_id, schedule range

Slot Available &
No Schedule Conflict?

[422 Slot Unavailable / Conflict]
Alert driver: Slot just booked or time window invalid.
Prompt alternative slot or schedule

Database: Create Reservation Record
• INSERT INTO reservations (status: 'pending')
• Generate unique secure QR Token & Reference Code
• Calculate estimated total parking fee

Database: Dispatch Notification
• INSERT INTO mobile_notifications
• Dispatch FCM / In-App push alert to Host

Host Reviews Incoming Booking
Provider opens Owner Reservations Screen
[GET /api/owner/reservations?status=pending]

Host Accept
Reservation?

[PATCH /api/owner/reservations/{id}/reject]
Set status='rejected' with owner_response_notes.
Release slot lock & notify Driver

[PATCH /api/owner/reservations/{id}/approve]
Set status='confirmed', activate reservation QR token,
notify Driver with confirmed schedule pass

Database: Update Reservation Status
UPDATE reservations SET status='confirmed'

Booking Confirmed & QR Pass Issued
Driver receives Confirmation Alert & Dynamic QR Pass
Reservation listed in Driver Active Schedule

PHASE 4

CHECK-IN, ACTIVE
PARKING &
COMMUNICATION

• In-App Chat & Voice Call
• QR Scanner Checkpoint
• Real-Time Entry/Exit Logs
• Overstay Monitoring
• Reservation Extensions

In-App Communication (Driver)
• Chat messaging [POST /conversation/messages]
• Initiate Voice Call [POST /conversation/calls]

Conversation & WebRTC / Agora Signaling
Exchange message polling / WebSocket events,
relay RTC SDP tokens & ICE signals

In-App Communication (Host)
• Reply to Driver in-app messages
• Accept / reject incoming voice calls

Driver Arrives at Parking Space
Driver opens app and presents active QR Pass on screen

Host / Guard Scans Driver QR Pass
Host opens QR Scanner Screen (or manual code entry)
[POST /api/owner/checkpoints/validate]

Validate Checkpoint Credential
Verify QR token authenticity, parking_space_id match,
vehicle plate number, and arrival grace time window

QR Token &
Schedule Valid?

Checkpoint Rejection Alert
Display error: Unmatched Space, Already Used, or Invalid Pass

Database: Check-In Entry Transaction
• UPDATE reservations SET status='checked_in'
• INSERT INTO checkpoint_transactions (type: 'check_in', timestamp)

Active Parking Session Monitor
Driver UI displays live parking timer, space location,
overstay countdown alert, and Request Extension button

Driver Requests Extension (Optional)
[PATCH /api/driver/reservations/{id}/extension]
Provide requested extension_end_time & reason

Host Evaluates Extension Request
[PATCH /api/owner/reservations/{id}/extension/approve]
or reject based on upcoming slot bookings

Automated Overstay & Abandoned Monitor
Server checks overstay_grace_minutes threshold.
Applies overtime multiplier rates if driver exceeds schedule

Driver Prepares to Depart
Driver presents Departure QR Pass to Host / Guard

Host Scans Check-Out QR Pass
[POST /api/owner/checkpoints/validate]
Trigger Check-Out Exit event validation

Calculate Final Duration & Billing
Compute exact parked duration, overtime penalty hours,
slot fee rate, and compile total payable breakdown

Database: Check-Out Exit Transaction
• UPDATE reservations SET status='completed'
• INSERT INTO checkpoint_transactions (type: 'check_out')
• INSERT INTO qr_transaction_logs (audit data)

Display Payable Balance & Receipt
Driver views total charges breakdown and payment options
Valid Pass

PHASE 5

PAYMENT, REVIEWS,
DISPUTE &
AUDIT TRAIL

• Cash & E-Wallet Settlement
• Payment Proof Verification
• Star Rating & Review System
• Dispute Resolution Console
• End-to-End Activity Logs

Select Payment
Method?

Pay Cash on Facility Check-out
Driver hands cash payment directly to Host / Guard

Host Confirms Cash Received
[PATCH /api/owner/reservations/{id}/mark-paid]
Set payment_method='cash', payment_status='paid'

PayMongo / E-Wallet Payment
[POST /api/driver/reservations/{id}/payment]
Driver completes checkout (GCash/Maya) or proof upload

Host Inspects Payment Proof
[GET /api/owner/reservations/{id}/payment-proof]
View digital screenshot & confirm transaction

[API Controller: Confirm Payment]
Verify transaction balance, update payment flags

Database: Update Payment Status
UPDATE reservations SET payment_status='paid',
paid_at=NOW()

Driver Submits Star Rating & Feedback
[POST /api/driver/reservations/{id}/feedback]
Rate 1 to 5 Stars with written review comments

API Review Processor
Insert feedback, compute parking space aggregate star average,
and refresh public space score

Database: Insert Feedback & Recalculate Rating
• INSERT INTO reviews (rating, comment)
• UPDATE parking_spaces SET rating=AVG(rating)

Dispute or Support Ticket (Optional)
Driver or Host files issue regarding overcharges,
damages, or reservation discrepancies

Admin Reviews Disputes & Support Requests
[GET /api/admin/reservations?dispute_status=pending]
[GET /api/admin/support-requests?status=open]

Admin Resolves Dispute Ticket
[PATCH /api/admin/reservations/{id}]
Set dispute_status='resolved', add dispute_notes & admin_internal_notes

Automated System Activity & Audit Engine
Record all critical security, reservation status transitions,
KYC decisions, checkpoint scans & payments

Database: Store Audit Logs & QR Logs
• INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action, ip, payload)
• INSERT INTO qr_transaction_logs

Admin System Activity & Audit Dashboard
[GET /api/admin/activity]
Monitor real-time system health, logs & financial metrics

Final Completed Summary & Digital Receipt
Driver views completed reservation history with receipt,
vehicle slots updated, and session closed
PayMongo (GCash/Maya)
Audit Stream
